title: Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Labor Rates for Several Televisions
content:
How the televisions on a Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge are priced follows how many the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation appointment mounts — the television units sold on the purchase being delivered less the television units returned from it, as that purchase's lines under Northgate Purchases & Returns show them.

| Televisions mounted | How the labor fee for each television is taken over them |
|---|---|
| Three or more | The first television at the full labor fee and every other one at half of it (0.5 of the fee) |
| Exactly two | The first television at the full labor fee and the second at three quarters of it (0.75 of the fee) |
| One | That television at the full labor fee |

The priced labor is the labor fee for each television taken over the televisions as this table prices them.

## Worked cases (hypothetical labor fee of $200.00)

| Televisions mounted | Labor fees taken | Priced labor |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | $200.00 |
| 2 | 1 plus 0.75, 1.75 | $350.00 |
| 3 | 1 plus 0.5 plus 0.5, 2 | $400.00 |
| 4 | 1 plus three times 0.5, 2.5 | $500.00 |

Returned televisions are not mounted: a purchase with four television units sold and two returned mounts two, priced as exactly two.
